title: New Relic License key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: literal marker: FFFFNRAL -> FFFFNRAI on an otherwise valid 40-character value (the NRAL suffix is provider-documented) (basis: provider). Twin of "New Relic License key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
